# ECN-2026-050 Change notice - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-RR03

Reason for change
- Field verification during setup identified that tooling limits and the control system parameter did not reflect the final customer requirement for larger parts. To ensure safe operation and prevent out-of-tolerance production, the equipment configuration and applicable procedures must be updated to reflect the allowable ring size for the mill.
- The maximum ring outer diameter for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #3 (EQ-P2-L2-RR03) is 1525 mm.

Affected items
- Machine parameter set and machine nameplate on EQ-P2-L2-RR03.
- Operator and maintenance procedures that reference ring size limits: SOP-P2-L2-05.
- Preventive maintenance and inspection checklists referenced in MM-P2-L2-RR03.
- Safety bulletin and hazard assessment: SB-1017.

Implementation
- Update machine parameter documentation and the electronic control profile to match the specified maximum ring outer diameter. Apply updated configuration to EQ-P2-L2-RR03 during the next scheduled downtime window coordinated by production planning.
- Revise SOP-P2-L2-05 to include the verified size limit, operational checks, and required tooling confirmation steps prior to setup for rings approaching the maximum outer diameter.
- Revise MM-P2-L2-RR03 maintenance entries to include visual verification of nameplate and parameter integrity after configuration change, and to reference SB-1017 for any safety-related modifications.
- Post updated notices at the machine and within the control room. Circulate revised procedure copies and provide a one-time training brief to operators and maintenance personnel covering the change and the implications for setup and inspection.

Approvals
- Engineering change approved by Plant Engineering and Operations leadership. Required references: MM-P2-L2-RR03, SB-1017, SOP-P2-L2-05.
- Final implementation authorization to be documented in the equipment log on EQ-P2-L2-RR03 after completion of updates and training.
